verdict.rationale: Kimi Code Desktop and the CLI let the agent act on the user's own machine: it can open a local project, read and edit files, run terminal commands, and verify results. That is a narrow, developer-focused form of operating the computer. The rest of the pack (agent mode, browser extension) only names features without saying they can see or control local applications. missing for 10: screen perception / GUI application control (true computer-use), operation of arbitrary desktop apps beyond terminal and files, independent hands-on corroboration of local agent operation.
